title: DeepCirc-interp: interpretability companion code, supplementary figures and tables
description: Interpretability companion code for the DeepCirc paper (Palacios et al.). Includes target Boolean function selection, topology population generation via upstream DeepCirc, Stage-2 MLP training and design-space scoring, cross-topology analyses, and per-design Shapley and Shapley-Taylor attribution. The v1.1 setFinalvF update adds consolidated supplementary figures S10 and S11 and tables S1-S3, with family-unique coalition sampling corrections and regenerated intermediate data, alongside the preserved v1.0 setFinal figure set. Source archives contain scripts, small intermediate data, and tracked supplementary table deliverables. Generated figure artwork must be attached separately. The upstream training framework is referenced as a pinned Git submodule.
notes: The source repository includes small intermediate data for figure rebuilding. Full training checkpoints, design-space predictions, exemplar HDF5 data, and the upstream private submodule are not bundled in a standard source archive; do not assume a full-data tier is available unless listed in the record. The manually uploaded archive series has concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20576708; use its new-version workflow to continue that series. See docs/zenodo_release.md.
